task_current: SOTA NLI Model Research (CPU/Low-RAM) - Evidence Gathered

decisions.decision: ModernBERT-based models (e.g., ModernCE-base-nli or EttinX-nli-s) are the primary candidates due to superior efficiency and comparable/better accuracy than DeBERTa-v3-base.
decisions.rationale: ModernBERT offers extended context (8k) and higher throughput with smaller parameter counts (68M-149M) while maintaining ~90% MNLI accuracy.

continuation: Synthesize evidence into a recommendation for the best NLI model for Zen 2 CPU < 2GB RAM. Compare ModernBERT vs DeBERTa-v3 distilled variants. Define the optimization pipeline (CTranslate2 vs Optimum).
